The line crosses the following live On strokes. It is an insertion leader, not a cancellation of On. The local layout preserves that crossing and all words. C and H omit the physical sweep; H’s different word/attachment readings remain the previously recorded comparisons rather than new lexical findings. Main confirmed the sweep and live On.

The first frame is drawn in three parts: a separate left side; a joined upper/right run; and a lower run with a short right upturn. White gaps remain at upper left, lower left and between the descending right side and the lower right upturn. Both witnesses use a fully closed boxed frame. Preserve the three separate parts and gaps while leaving every enclosed formula glyph unchanged. Main confirmed all three gaps.

The second frame has a separate upper run, a joined left/lower run, and a right side with a short lower foot. White gaps remain at upper left, upper right and between the long lower run and the right foot. Both witnesses close the frame. The proposed paths retain those three gaps without changing the enclosed primed Lambda factors. Main confirmed the three gaps.

notes: The second reading adds ten local graphic findings: three continuous insertion leaders, the segmented construction of each relation-(14) frame, the fine oblique trace at the first frame, and four pencil-skeleton details. The dernière leader is a curved sweep with no imposed arrowhead; its right tip meets an old tall cancelled stroke. The two resp. leaders have downward left curls and upward right curls, and the second crosses the following live On without cancelling it. The frame gaps are retained separately for each box. The fine oblique trace is physically present but its origin/function remains uncertain. At outer1 the three pencil tips are separate; at the upper-left corner the horizontal has a short overhang and a faint inward oblique; near infinity the incoming upper segment hooks downward, with an intervening faint contour whose continuity is unresolved. All these candidates were independently reviewed by the main reader using the existing crops. The old cancellations and their three textual doubts remain unresolved. Formula (13) retains the first lambda’s tau index without a supplied r, the clearly closed sigma in the second lambda, the final target’s lone i−1, and both literal shaft-plus-upper-tick connectors. These are the written forms even where comparison with the nearby tau notation raises a mathematical question. All existing drawing labels, directed dark paths, overworked residues and the uncertain upper lambda_r^1 endpoint are retained. No source-mark decisions changed. No algebraic proof or new mathematical check was performed; reading (13) and (14) is not counted as proof.

hand_log.habit: Insertion leaders may be long continuous sweeps with a downward-curled left stem and upward right curl, and may cross neighbouring live or cancelled letter strokes without themselves being cancellations.
hand_log.universality: Observed in the three local leaders for dernière and the two resp. insertions; no claim beyond these occurrences.
misread_places: C and H encode the three insertions without their physical leaders; the consolidated draft likewise omitted their strokes. The second resp. leader crosses live On and must not make it deleted.

coverage: Personally viewed the original once and both native overlapping halves once, reading all prose, punctuation, formula symbols, indices, primes, cancellations, insertions, diagram labels, dark path endpoints and pencil framework before consulting the current mark/doubt descriptions. Reused twelve existing crops for concrete questions: dernière leader, both resp. leaders, formula14 frames/trace, formula13 indices/caps, the three crowded textual cancellations, and four local drawing regions. All 15 successful image views are listed in order. No new crop, recrop, OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used.
